questions.question: Across all returns, were there more single returns filed than joint returns?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_soi_individual_returns_by_state_us.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1', header=None)
single_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Number of single returns', case=False, na=False)].iloc[0]
joint_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Number of joint returns', case=False, na=False)].iloc[0]
single_val = float(single_row[1])
joint_val = float(joint_row[1])
result = 'yes' if single_val > joint_val else 'no'

questions.question: What are the three adjusted gross income brackets with the greatest number of returns claiming the earned income credit?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd
import json

df = pd.read_excel('irs_soi_individual_returns_by_state_us.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1', header=None)
eic_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.startswith('Earned income credit:')].iloc[0]
bracket_labels = df.iloc[4, 2:12].tolist()
values = pd.to_numeric(eic_row.iloc[2:12]).tolist()
sorted_pairs = sorted(zip(values, bracket_labels), key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
top_3 = [pair[1] for pair in sorted_pairs[:3]]
result = top_3

questions.question: What is the difference between the total income tax before credits and total income tax after credits across all returns, in thousands of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_soi_individual_returns_by_state_us.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1', header=None)
before_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Income tax before credits:', case=False, na=False)].index[0] + 1
after_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Income tax after credits:', case=False, na=False)].index[0] + 1
before_amt = float(df.iloc[before_idx, 1])
after_amt = float(df.iloc[after_idx, 1])
result = int(before_amt - after_amt)
